body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Toshiba presented its 2007 REGZA 1080p Full HD LCD TV series during CES 2007. The HL167 series adopted the company’s PixelPure, ColorBurst, and Dynalight technologies to offer enhanced color reproduction and contrast ratio.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Nikki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Seo >
